I’ll extract employees, profiles, and gifts, then match gifts to interests to see who received a gift.

```python
from docx import Document

docx_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/cffe0e32-c9a6-4c52-9877-78ceb4aaa9fb.docx"
document = Document(docx_path)

# Employees (2-13)
employees = [document.paragraphs[i].text.strip() for i in range(2,14) if document.paragraphs[i].text.strip()]

# Profiles (21-32)
profiles = {}
for i in range(21,33):
    line = document.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if ":" in line:
        name, rest = line.split(":", 1)
        profiles[name.strip()] = [x.strip() for x in rest.split(",")]

# Gifts (36-46)
gifts = [document.paragraphs[i].text.strip() for i in range(36,47) if document.paragraphs[i].text.strip()]

# Map gifts to interests
gift_interest_map = {
    "Galileo Galilei biography": "Astronomy",
    "Fishing reel": "Fishing",
    "Raku programming guide": "Perl",
    "Chisel set": "Woodworking",
    "Custom dice": "Tabletop RPGs",
    "“War and Peace” American film copy": "Old Movies",
    "Yarn": "Knitting",
    "“One Piece” graphic novel": "Manga",
    "“War and Peace” novel": "Historical Fiction Novels",
    "Starbucks gift card": "Coffee",
    "Foam exercise mat": "Yoga",
}

matched = set()
for gift, interest in gift_interest_map.items():
    for name, ints in profiles.items():
        if interest in ints:
            matched.add(name)

missing = set(employees) - matched
print("Employees matched by interest/gift:")
print(sorted(matched))
print("\nMissing recipient(s):")
print(sorted(missing))
```
